contract_question: Will the regular-unary AxiomPack smoke return a receipted residual finalist with logical singleton ablation and a boundary result, or a valid receipted null?
rationale_short: Open micro contract with no aggregate, outcome, or score yet. The structure is narrow enough that a valid receipted null is plausible, but the success threshold still requires either a positive-residual finalist with singleton ablations and boundary evidence or a schema-valid no-candidate receipt. Main weakness is boundary/receipt completion under a short horizon; dependency risk is moderate because the objective relies on the immutable campaign run and reject-all receipts rather than a single proof step.
